title: Facet force at L3-L4 - Zhu Q et al. 2008 (Proc IMechE H, doi 10.1243/09544119JEIM290) (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: facet contact force by pressure-sensitive film (Tekscan), left and right facets, mean +/- SD

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.sample: not stated in review (see primary: Zhu Q et al. 2008 (Proc IMechE H, doi 10.1243/09544119JEIM290)); human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Zhu Q et al. 2008 (Proc IMechE H, doi 10.1243/09544119JEIM290), as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Pure moments 7.5 Nm; Tekscan pressure film inserted into the facet joints.
how_to_simulate: Report left and right L3-L4 facet contact force
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (Ghezelbash et al.'s review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Zhu Q et al. 2008 (Proc IMechE H, doi 10.1243/09544119JEIM290).

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output. | 2026-11-12: source.n was the primary paper year (2008); set to n=10 from Zhu 2008 (10 specimens).

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)
